Jennycruzy opened issue #111: RFC: temporal predicates for graph-context retrieval
Blastline uses HydraDB as the hosted graph layer for bitemporal supply-chain resolution evidence. The current graph-context and source-relation APIs retrieve the relevant graph neighborhood, but the client must apply transaction-time and valid-time interval predicates locally.

We propose optional temporal relation filters supporting: (1) commit-time cutoff, and (2) valid-time interval intersection. This keeps ordinary retrieval unchanged while allowing HydraDB to select the correct historical graph slice server-side.

The complete use case, proposed request shape, response requirements, and reproducible implementation context are documented here:
https://github.com/Jennycruzy/blastline/blob/main/docs/RFC_HYDRA_TEMPORAL_PREDICATES.md

This is based on HydraDB's published bitemporal edge model and Blastline's 54-repository supply-chain graph. Happy to adapt the proposal to the project's preferred API conventions.
